description: Source code for PWM driver in an AUTOSAR-based embedded system, including initialization, configuration, and interrupt handling for PWM channels on MPC55xx microcontrollers.

methods.name: Pwm_ValidateInitialized
methods.description: Checks if the PWM module is initialized.

methods.name: Pwm_ValidateChannel
methods.description: Validates if a PWM channel number is within valid range.

methods.name: calcPeriodTicksAndPrescaler
methods.description: Calculates timer ticks and prescaler based on channel configuration.

methods.name: configureChannel
methods.description: Configures a PWM channel hardware registers based on configuration.

methods.name: Pwm_Init
methods.description: Initializes PWM channels and hardware based on provided configuration.

methods.name: Pwm_DeInit
methods.description: Deinitializes PWM channels and disables hardware.

methods.name: Pwm_SetPeriodAndDuty
methods.description: Sets the period and duty cycle for a PWM channel.

methods.name: Pwm_SetDutyCycle
methods.description: Sets the duty cycle for a PWM channel.

methods.name: Pwm_SetOutputToIdle
methods.description: Sets PWM output to idle state.

methods.name: Pwm_GetOutputState
methods.description: Returns current output state of PWM channel.

methods.name: Pwm_DisableNotification
methods.description: Disables notification for a PWM channel.

methods.name: Pwm_EnableNotification
methods.description: Enables notification for a PWM channel.

methods.name: Pwm_Isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine for PWM channel events.
